settings.heading: Made by film lovers, for film lovers.

settings.text: Live Forever Film Lab is a boutique, premium quality film lab that began with a simple idea: to build the lab we always wished existed. As photographers ourselves, we knew what mattered most ... highest-quality scans, fast turnarounds, and a personalised process. So we set out to create a place where film is treated with the same care we give our own rolls.

We process C41 colour negative, black & white, and ECN-2 cine film with precision and consistency. In our Surry Hills lab, legendary equipment meets quality chemistry and meticulous attention to detail.

Choose from our Social, Standard (Large), or Pro (XL) sized scans. Set your own contrast preferences, or trust our lab defaults - either way, our aim is to get the best out of your film for your individual needs, and deliver results you’ll love. You can even select from our suite of classic lab scanners, including Noritsu (our default), the beloved Fujifilm Frontier or the cult classic Kodak Pakon.

settings.heading: Who We Are
settings.text: Live Forever Film Lab is a premium quality, independent film lab that began with a simple idea: to build the lab we always wished existed. As photographers ourselves, we knew what mattered most — beautiful scans, fast turnarounds, and a personal process. So we set out to create a place where film is treated with the same care we give our own rolls.

settings.heading: What We Do
settings.text:
We process C41 colour negative, black & white, and ECN-2 cine film with precision and consistency. In our Surry Hills lab, legendary equipment meets quality chemistry and meticulous attention to detail.

Choose from our Social, Classic, or Pro sized scans — each one consistent, crafted, and designed to bring out the best in your images. Set your own contrast preferences, or trust our lab defaults — either way, our aim is to deliver results you’ll love. You can even select from our suite of classic lab scanners, including the Noritsu (our default) or the beloved Fujifilm Frontier.

settings.heading: Visit or Send Your Film
settings.subtext:
Located in the heart of Surry Hills above Title Bookstore, our lab is open for in-person drop-offs and pickups. If you can’t make it
during reception hours, our film drop-off boxes offer a flexible alternative - or you can mail your rolls from anywhere. However
it reaches us, your film is handled with the same care and high standards, and we’ll keep you updated every step of the way. For us, film photography is more than a process - it’s a community - so please keep an eye out for one of our upcoming events.

settings.text:
Film Developing & Scanning: Professionally processed using calibrated machines and hand-checked by passionate lab technicians.
High-Resolution Scans: Crisp, true-to-tone scans that bring out the best in your negatives — ready for digital use without losing the film character.
Archival Handling: Your film is safely stored and returned with care, ensuring each roll is preserved for years to come.
Shop for Film & Gear: We stock iconic emulsions and reliable tools — because the right materials make all the difference.

At Live Forever Film Lab, we believe film isn’t just photography — it’s a ritual. Every roll tells a story, every frame holds emotion, and every grain carries soul.
Born from a love of analog processes and timeless images, our lab was created to give film photographers the care and quality they deserve.

Have a Project in Mind? We're here to help bring your vision to life – whether you're outfitting a sports team in Upper Arlington or planning an event across the country. Stop by our store if you're local, or reach out to our team today!
